sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: The basic forms here are *vagyok*, vagy and van.

vagyok, vagy, van barely look like forms of the same verb, and that’s because lenni is Hungarian’s most irregular verb — even native kids just memorize the set. Try chanting them in order until the rhythm sticks. One thing to watch for later: van quietly disappears when you’re simply saying what someone IS rather than where they are — you’ll meet that gap very soon.
